title: All Who Love Duality Are Ruined
summary: Ego is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained; all who love duality are ruined
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained; all who love duality are ruined
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Acting in egotism, peace is not obtained; all who love duality are ruined
evidence.turn: Ego steadies when nanak, the lowly, says embrace love for the Lord.
